newsitem.title: FINLAND: MONETARY EASING NO AID TO JOBLESSNESS - FINLAND BANK.
newsitem.headline: MONETARY EASING NO AID TO JOBLESSNESS - FINLAND BANK.

text.p: Lower interest rates would not solve the employment problem in Finland, Bank of Finland governor Sirkka Hamalainen told a seminar on Monday.
"The unemployment problem cannot be solved by loosening total fiscal policy or easing monetary policy," she said.
She noted that 57 percent of companies' costs are labour costs while only seven percent are financial costs.
"This who call for lower interest rates have lost the perspective, particularly with regard to the current level of interest rates," she said.
The Bank of Finland's main monetary policy tool -- the tender rate is currently 3.10 percent -- 10 basis points above the German repo rate, and among the lowest key rates in Europe.
